regime_context: The detector shows a broad thematic rotation (65% of themes eligible) with the top momentum leader (Memory/HBM) showing fading momentum (negative 10-day return, 'fading' state, low durability and zero breadth). The absolute-trend gate is the only validated risk-control edge. The challenger Cybersecurity has strong trend durability and breadth but is crowded. Historical track record is poor (2/5 hits, directional accuracy 0.2), forcing low conviction overall.
emerging_watch: Cybersecurity: the rotation challenger with strong durability (0.84), high breadth, but crowded. Watch for a confirmed handoff if it surpasses Memory in momentum score while staying eligible and durability above 0.8. Kill-criterion: durability drops below 0.7 or fails to capture rank #1 by mid-August 2026.

theses.subject: Energy (Equal-Weight)
theses.thesis: Despite a mid-pack momentum rank, Energy (Equal-Weight) exhibits high trend durability, a trending Hurst regime, very high breath (broad participation), and no crowding — suggesting a sustained, broad-based advance that may benefit from the drawdown-control edge of the absolute-trend gate.
theses.dissent: Energy is cyclical and highly sensitive to global growth shocks, oil price drops, or geopolitical de-escalation, any of which could reverse the trend abruptly.

falsifier.text: If durability falls below 0.60 or breadth drops below 0.70 within 20 trading days.

theses.subject: Memory, HBM & Storage
theses.thesis: The theme holds the top momentum score but its recent performance is deteriorating (r10 negative, val_state 'fading'), with low durability (0.46) and zero breadth — a classic fragile-leader profile. While the absolute-trend gate has not failed, the coincident signals indicate elevated risk of mean-reversion or rotation out of the theme.
theses.dissent: A fresh AI infrastructure capex catalyst (e.g., hyperscaler earnings) could reignite momentum; the absolute trend still holds and the gate historically reduces drawdown, so the theme may resume leadership.

falsifier.text: If the theme's 10-day return turns positive AND durability rises above 0.70 within 15 trading days.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
